automagia.entity_eye.blank: Imprint the eye on a creature first
automagia.golem_inhibitor.exclusive: The inhibitor now holds linked golems only
automagia.golem_inhibitor.omit: The inhibitor now leaves linked golems alone
automagia.golem_linker.attuned: The bell is attuned to the %s
automagia.golem_linker.unattuned: Attune the bell to a device first
automagia.inventarium.linked: Linked to the Inventarium core at %s, %s, %s
automagia.inventarium.no_room: The core has no room for another device
automagia.inventarium.status: Slots %s of %s, scribes %s of %s, memory %s of %s
automagia.inventarium.structure: The Inventarium is not built: order cluster below the core, amber below that, eight archive shelves around it
automagia.locus.unformed: The locus is not built: cluster below it, lapis below that, ringed by water and silverwood planks
automagia.locus.unlinked: Attune the eye to a jar within %s blocks first
automagia.msg.avarice_insight: The shattered pearl still tugs at the world. There is more to learn from it.
automagia.msg.eye_unattuned: You must attune the eye to a location before placing it here.
automagia.msg.mirror_unlinked: Link it to a magic mirror first.
automagia.msg.needs_ordo: You need a wand with some order in it.
automagia.msg.redcrystal_cap: Redstone signal strength cap set to %s.
automagia.msg.redcrystal_min: Redstone signal strength minimum set to %s.
automagia.msg.too_far: It must be placed within %s blocks of its mirror.
automagia.msg.unbound: Bind it to a magic mirror first: right-click the mirror with it.
automagia.nethermind.invalidMix: Block runes and creature runes cannot be mixed.
automagia.nethermind.missingLure: No Dimensional Lure, ringed by plain runed obsidian, lies 6 to 10 blocks straight below through open air.
automagia.nethermind.missingLureExtraDis: The Dimensional Lure is too close: a ghast rune needs it at least 8 blocks down.
automagia.nethermind.needMoreMobRunes: Creature runes need at least four of their kind to call anything.
automagia.nethermind.noVis: The wand has too little vis to wake the Nethermind.
automagia.nethermind.structure: The Nethermind needs eighteen runed obsidian around it: a ring of eight, one above, one below, and two out from each side.
automagia.nethermind.yTooLow: The Nethermind is too close to the bottom of the world.
automagia.node_jar.research: You do not know how to jar a node this way
automagia.node_jar.structure: The jar is not built right: warded glass walls, silverwood logs on top
automagia.node_jar.vis: You need %s of each primal vis in a wand on your hotbar
automagia.siren_lure.totems: The lure needs at least two obsidian totems above or below it.
automagia.spire.structure: The spire is not built right: chiseled quartz, two or more pylons and the controller, thaumium under open sky
automagia.tip.ender_disjunction: Hurts teleporting endermen, endermites and shulkers nearby
automagia.tome.no_taskmaster: No golemic taskmaster is linked to the Inventarium
automagia.tome.unlinked: The tome is not linked to an Inventarium
automagia.tome.vis_low: The aura is too weak to send the order
research.automagia.advanced_node_jar.sta: There must be a way to jar a node without the strain of it wearing the node down.

Your warding magic steadies the jar enough that the node comes through unharmed. Build the node jar around the node as usual, but with warded glass for the glass and silverwood logs for the slabs on top.

Then right-click one of the logs with a wand that has no focus. If you carry the usual vis, the node is jarred at once, and it keeps its brightness.
research.automagia.alchemy_boiler.stage_: You have had so much success distilling essentia from things that you would like to break down more of them. Liquids, for a start.

The alchemical boiler works much as the alchemical furnace does, but on liquids instead of items. Fill it with buckets, pipes or golems, and feed it furnace fuel; alumentum makes it boil twice as fast. It boils a bucket at a time and sends the essentia up into the alembics stacked on top of it.

Only liquids with aspects can be boiled. Right-click it with an empty hand to see what it holds. Breaking the boiler loses whatever liquid is in it.
research.automagia.alchemy_boiler.title: Alchemical Boiler
research.automagia.amnesiastone.stage_0: What we learn by doing lingers in us as a faint glow. A stone that made us forget could catch it.
research.automagia.amnesiastone.stage_1:
Right-click the Amnesiac's Stone to give up a level of experience, five while sneaking; stand on it to give up everything, a level at a time. Bottles o' enchanting thrown or dropped onto it give theirs too. The experience goes into a brain in a jar standing on the stone, or comes out above it as orbs.

Sneak and right-click that brain jar with an empty hand to pour out everything it holds. A comparator reads how full the brain is.
research.automagia.amnesiastone.title: Amnesiac's Stone
research.automagia.auto_hand_mirror.stag: A finical maw's appetite, set behind the glass of a hand mirror, would feed the mirror network from your own pockets.

Link the hungry hand mirror to a magic mirror the way you link a hand mirror. It then holds up to two runic lists and sends what you pick up through the link on its own, but only items a list names: a whitelist sends what it names, a blacklist with quantities sends whatever you hold beyond each quantity.

With a runic list in your other hand, right-click to put the list in; with anything else there, right-click to shove that stack through by hand. Sneak-right-click with the other hand empty takes the lists out.
research.automagia.avaricious.stage_0: The shards of the broken pearl still tug at everything nearby. There is more to learn from them.
research.automagia.avaricious.stage_1: The miser's pearl is an avarice pearl made patient: it gathers items as it flies, up to ten stacks, and costs no health. Each throw draws a little order from a wand you carry.
research.automagia.avaricious.title: Avaricious
research.automagia.congregatrix.stage_1: Golems can fetch and carry. With a little help they can make things too, and keep a thaumaturge supplied while they do: the golem's workbench and its upgrades, and the thaumostatic spire.
research.automagia.congregatrix.title: Congregatrix
research.automagia.crystal_brain.stage_0: A golem's brain does what it is told and nothing more. A brain grown through with crystal, steeped in one primal aspect, might hold on to more than an order.
research.automagia.crystal_brain.stage_1: Drop a brain into a crucible that holds eight vitreus and eight of a primal aspect, and it comes out as a crystalline brain of that aspect. They are the heart of the devices that watch and direct golems. JEI shows the essentia each one needs.
research.automagia.crystal_brain.title: Crystalline Brain
research.automagia.dimensionlure.stage_0: Blocks are easily pulled across. Living things cling to their own world and need somewhere to arrive.
research.automagia.dimensionlure.stage_1:
Creature runes call creatures instead of blocks, through a Dimensional Lure. Put the lure 6 to 10 blocks straight below the Nethermind with open air between them (ghasts need at least 8), and ring it at its height with eight plain runed obsidian. The Nethermind needs four or more creature runes and no block runes; it pays each rune's essentia, and the lure's alienis and motus every four creatures.

The rift is unstable: now and then it spills flux and lets two through instead of one. Obsidian totems stood on the ring's four corners and a nitor nearby calm it. No more than eight of a kind gather near the lure.
research.automagia.dimensionlure.title: Dimensional Lure
research.automagia.eager_chest.stage_0: A greedy chest only ever takes. Turned the other way, the same cunning could serve whoever opens it.
research.automagia.eager_chest.stage_1:
The eager chest knows its owner, who places it, and anyone the owner introduces (the stranger right-clicks it with a wand). When someone it knows opens it, it trades with them first by its two runic lists: the Give list hands them what it names, the Take list takes from them what it names (a blacklist takes everything else, but never from the hotbar or armour). A quantity on a Give list is how many they should end up with, and on a Take list it is how many they keep. With no list in a slot it does nothing that way. Sneak-right-click opens it without a trade.

The Trade setting turns the trading on or off, and List Slot picks which list a runic list goes into.
research.automagia.eager_chest.title: Eager Chest
research.automagia.enchant_fishing.stage: Infusion can raise an enchantment as well as bestow one. Fishing rods are a fine place to start.

Put a fishing rod on the infusion altar's pedestal with the components around it: each infusion raises Lure or Luck of the Sea by one level, up to their highest, and the essentia grows with the level it reaches. The rod's other enchantments stay as they are.
research.automagia.enchant_fishing.title: Fishing Enchantments
research.automagia.enchanted_paper.stage: Some instructions carry more weight than ink can give them. Paper steeped in vis and inlaid with golden runes could enforce its writing on the devices that read it.

Enchanted paper is made at the arcane workbench. Written as a runic whitelist or blacklist, it tells devices which items to see. Right-click a list to write it: put an item into a slot, hold an empty hand over a slot to clear it, and scroll over a slot to set a quantity (one means none). The Partial button makes a list match by item alone, ignoring damage and other details.

A whitelist becomes a blacklist with a sliver of entropy, and back again with a sliver of order, keeping what is written on it. Two lists in a crafting grid copy the first onto the second, and the first comes back.

Bound into a book, enchanted paper makes an enchanting bookshelf: four times as potent as a bookshelf, so four bring an enchanting table to level 30.
research.automagia.enchanted_paper.title: Enchanted Paper
research.automagia.ender_disjunction.sta: Endermen step through space as we step through a door. A ring could slam that door on them.

A ring of ender disjunction, worn in a ring slot, hurts every enderman, endermite or shulker that teleports within range of you, where it leaves or where it arrives. Each time costs one perditio, taken from a phial, an essentia jar or a perditio crystal you carry. The lesser ring hurts less and reaches eight blocks instead of sixteen; a second ring adds half its own strength. Both rings take runic shielding.
research.automagia.entity_signal.stage_0: A crystalline eye sees a place. A crystalline brain behind it could tell what moves there.
research.automagia.entity_signal.stage_1:
Imprint an Oculo Anima by right-clicking a creature with it, or another player. Sneak-right-click the air to imprint yourself, and again for any player at all.

Put the imprinted eye into a Signum Entia (an empty hand takes it back). It counts the matching creatures nearby and gives that count as a redstone signal, to its neighbours and to comparators. It watches eleven blocks across. A solid block against one of its faces turns the watched area away from that side; blocks against two opposite faces flatten it to the device's own layer. Glass doesn't block. Right-click it with a wand to count only adults, only young, or all.
research.automagia.entity_signal.title: Signum Entia
research.automagia.entropic_refining.sta: The shards you break from a crystal cluster hold only part of the magic grown into it. Entropy could break out more of it, if in smaller pieces.
Drop a crystal cluster of one of the primal aspects into a crucible that holds perditio, and it comes apart into four slivers of its own aspect. JEI shows the essentia each one needs.
research.automagia.essentia_aggregator.s: Once the locus knows where all your essentia is, it ought to be able to hand it out.

Set an essentia aggregator directly on top of an essentia locus, and the locus becomes a source of essentia for everything nearby that draws from jars: essentia mirrors, the runic matrix during an infusion, and the like. What they draw is taken from the jars the locus watches, so a single place can count your essentia, feed your mirrors and supply your infusions.
research.automagia.essentia_locus.stage_: A system to gather up and guide the essentia across all your territory has to start somewhere. Its nerve centre will be a locus that knows what every jar holds.

Build the locus on a water crystal cluster that sits on a block of lapis lazuli. Ring the lapis with eight water sources, and wall the water in with sixteen silverwood planks. Place the essentia locus last, on top of the cluster.

Then point it at warded jars with crystalline eyes: attune an eye to a jar and right-click the locus with it. An eye counts that jar and every jar or essentia reservoir joined to it. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take the last eye out; right-click with an empty hand to see the totals.

One eye and twelve jars at first, within sixteen blocks. Each further water crystal cluster set against the planks adds an eye, eight jars and eight blocks of reach. A comparator or vis reader next to the locus, or a remote comparator watching it, reads the total.
research.automagia.essentia_locus.title: Essentia Locus
research.automagia.finical_maw.stage_0: A hungry maw eats anything. A pickier one would be far more useful.
research.automagia.finical_maw.stage_1: The finical maw takes a runic list: right-click it with one to put it in, sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take it out. With a whitelist it swallows only what the list names, and a quantity stops it once its container holds that many. With a blacklist it swallows everything else, and named items only until the container holds their quantity. Without a list it eats nothing.
research.automagia.finical_maw.title: Finical Maw
research.automagia.focus_crafting.stage_: Why walk back to the workbench? A focus could carry the workbench with it.

The Crafting effect opens an arcane crafting grid, with crystal slots, wherever you are. The caster in your hand pays the vis of arcane recipes, as at a workbench; opening the grid costs a little vis and each arcane craft a little more. A blank lesser focus between crafting tables and enchanted paper becomes a ready-made crafting focus (Self, then Crafting), or put Crafting in any focus of your own.

While a caster with a crafting focus is on your hotbar, the crafting key (K) opens the grid without casting.
research.automagia.focus_crafting.title: Wand Focus: Crafting
research.automagia.focus_crafting_upgrad: The crafting focus could do more, given more of the focus's complexity.

The Crafting effect gains three settings, each worth complexity: Gratis (opening and crafting cost no extra vis), Storage (whatever is left in the grid stays in the focus until next time) and Transposing (the crafting key also finds a crafting focus in your inventory or a focus pouch and puts it on your hotbar caster).
research.automagia.glowing_amber.stage_0: Amber holds what is trapped in it for ever. Why not a nitor?
research.automagia.glowing_amber.stage_1: A block of amber with a nitor sealed inside makes a steady, smokeless light. Four of them can be dressed into glowing amber bricks.
research.automagia.glowing_amber.title: Glowing Amber
research.automagia.golem_inhibitor.stage: A golem fetter holds the golems that stand on it. With a brain to reach further, it could hold them from a distance.

Set the inhibitor on top of a golem fetter. While that fetter is powered, golems within four blocks of the inhibitor stop as if they stood on it. Each further fetter stacked under the first, up to four in all, adds four blocks to the reach; only the powered ones count.

With no golems linked it holds every golem. Link golems to it with the linking bell and it leaves those alone; right-click it with a wand to hold only them instead, and again to switch back.
research.automagia.golem_inhibitor.title: Golemic Inhibitor
research.automagia.golem_linker.stage_0: A device that works with golems needs to know which golems are its own.
research.automagia.golem_linker.stage_1:
Right-click a golem device (an inhibitor or a workbench) with the linking bell to attune the bell to it, then right-click golems to link them to it. A device takes six golems; a golem belongs to one device at a time, and linking it again moves it.

Sneak-right-click the device with the bell to undo all its links, or sneak-right-click any other block to clear the bell.
research.automagia.golem_linker.title: Golem Linking Bell
research.automagia.golem_workbench.stage:
The golem's workbench lays out a crafting pattern clearly enough that even a golem can follow it. Write the pattern in the top left grid: click a place with an item to write it there, with an empty hand to erase it. Put the materials in the storage below. Only recipes a crafting table makes will do.

Link a golem to the bench with the linking bell and keep it within three blocks. It crafts the pattern whenever the storage has the ingredients and less than one craft of the product waiting, so let golems take the products away with seals and it keeps working. Leftovers such as empty buckets are thrown out on top.

Most golems can follow only patterns that fit in a 2x2 square, or that use a single kind of ingredient; smart golems, and golems of rank two and up, follow any. A powered golem fetter under the bench stops the crafting.

The golem tires as it works and slows down; a jar of fabrico within four blocks keeps it fresh.
research.automagia.golem_workbench.title: Golem's Workbench
research.automagia.greedy_chest.stage_0: The hunger in a hungry chest is a dumb, animal thing. Given a little cunning, it would stop waiting for food and go and take it.
research.automagia.greedy_chest.stage_1:
The greedy chest takes items from the containers beside it, twice a second. Configure it with a wand: right-click changes the selected setting, sneak-right-click selects the next one.

Pilfer Mode: Split New Contents (its percentage of whatever newly arrives next door), Maintain Percentage (its percentage of the combined total), Take Any Over (everything over the amount) or Maintain Stock (until it holds the amount). Percentage and Amount set those numbers, and Take From turns each side on or off. It never takes from a hopper under it, or from another greedy chest that takes from it.

Right-click it with a runic list to give it one: a whitelist makes it covet only what it names (a quantity on the list overrides the amount), a blacklist everything else. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to take the list out.

The avarice pearl carries the same greed: thrown, it lands and pulls the loose items around it, then flies back to you. Each throw risks a little of your health, and the pearl may shatter.
research.automagia.greedy_chest.title: Greedy Chest
research.automagia.hungry_maw.stage_0: A hungry chest's appetite is bound to its own box. If the hunger could be drawn out and set into a portable hole, it could be stuck onto any container.
research.automagia.hungry_maw.stage_1: A hungry chest between two blocks of obsidian yields two hungry maws. Place a maw on any face of a container: dropped items that touch it, or pass close by, are swallowed into the container through that face. A maw falls off if the block behind it is removed.
research.automagia.hungry_maw.title: Hungry Maw
research.automagia.inventarium.stage_0: Keeping track of what lies in a hundred chests is a chore that a well-ordered mind could take on, if that mind were bound to shelves of enchanted record.
research.automagia.inventarium.stage_1:
Set an Inventarium core on a cluster of order crystals that stands on amber (a block or bricks), then ring the core at its own height with eight archive shelves: bookshelves will do. Place the shelves last and right-click the core with a wand to form it. Every archive shelf within three blocks lets the core keep track of 81 more inventory slots.

An unseen scribe faces a container; that container's kind is the one it reads, in the 7x7x7 around the scribe. Right-click the scribe with a wand to link it to a core in range (the core you last right-clicked with a wand comes first, then the nearest). It draws a little order vis from the aura as it reads. A container that would not fit in the core's free slots is left out whole, with a puff of black smoke.

Right-click the scribe to see what it reads, or toggle to the whole Inventarium. The core starts with one scribe and a link range of ten blocks; every further order cluster in the 7x7x7 around the core adds a scribe and eight blocks of range. Right-click the core with a wand for its status. A tally box pointed at the core, or at one of its eight ring shelves, counts everything the Inventarium holds.
research.automagia.inventarium.title: Inventarium
Knowing where everything is, is half the work. Golems could do the other half, fetching on demand.

Memory blocks give a core room for more devices: put them in the 7x2x7 space starting two blocks below the core, each touching the amber. Each taskmaster, requisition tome and dispersing mirror linked to the core takes one.

The golemic taskmaster faces its drop-off, any container or mirror. It turns orders into provisioning requests there, one stack at a time, and golems on Provide seals bring what is asked for. A request no golem fills is asked once more, then dropped.

The requisition tome lists all the Inventarium holds. Click an item to order one more, right-click for one fewer; hold shift for a stack, ctrl for ten, alt to ask for more than is stored. Order sends the sheet to the taskmasters, at a little order vis. The tome's slots take two attuned crystalline eyes: an input mirror (items put in the tome's slot go through that mirror) and an output mirror (where dispersing mirrors send deliveries). A tally box on a tome counts what is still on order. Link each device to the core with a wand.
research.automagia.inventarium_extra.sta: Plain bookshelves hold so little. Enchanted paper is denser, and silverwood holds a charge.

An enchanting bookshelf in an Inventarium counts 216 slots instead of 81. The ensorcelled bookshelf, two enchanting bookshelves rebound in silverwood with a sliver of order, counts 486, and stands for eight bookshelves at an enchanting table.
research.automagia.inventarium_pointer.s: A scribe sees only what lies around it, and only one kind of container. Lend it more eyes.

Place a scrivener's oculus on an unseen scribe. It holds up to five crystalline eyes: right-click it with an attuned eye to put it in, with an empty hand to take the last one out. An eye attuned to a container adds that container's kind to what the scribe reads; an eye attuned to the scribe itself widens its area by one block each way.
research.automagia.magic_hourglass.stage: Mundane sand always flows on from where it stopped, and an hourglass cannot turn itself. Enchanted sand need not obey either rule.

The magic hourglass turns itself and is set with a wand. Right-click with the wand changes the selected setting, and sneak-right-click selects the next one.

The Mode setting picks Pulse (a pulse when the sand settles), Constant (a signal while sand falls), Alternating (on and off while it falls), Negative Pulse (a signal while sand falls that drops for a moment each time the glass turns itself over) or Disabled. With Repeat on, it turns itself over each time. The Redstone setting picks whether a signal starts it, it runs only while powered, only while unpowered, or it ignores redstone. Time goes from one second to an hour. On Reactivation decides what happens when the glass is activated while sand still falls. Sand to top starts it over, Sand to bottom ends it early with no signal and stops a repeat, and Flip turns it like a mundane glass.
research.automagia.magic_hourglass.title: Magic Hourglass
research.automagia.melding_mirror.stage_: Magic mirrors only link in pairs, so bringing many places to one costs a mirror pair each. Void metal could let a mirror borrow a pair's stream instead.

The melding mirror only takes items in. Instead of a partner it holds a crystalline eye: attune the eye to a magic mirror that is paired with another (anywhere, in any dimension) and right-click the melding mirror with it. Whatever is then thrown or piped into the melding mirror comes out of that pair's far mirror. Sneak-right-click it with a wand to take the eye out.

Its heart is the conflux disc. The first is costly; from one, more are made easily, so keep one in reserve.
research.automagia.melding_mirror.title: Melding Mirror
research.automagia.mirror_multidest.stag: Deliveries pile up at the taskmaster's feet. A mirror that knew who ordered what could send each order home.

Link a dispersing mirror to the core with a wand; it takes a memory block. While one is linked, taskmasters deliver to it every order from a tome that has an output mirror, and it sends each order on to that tome's output, a magic mirror or a melding mirror. Anything that is not on order is spat out.
research.automagia.moblure.stage_0: Creatures follow the call of what they want. An obsidian totem sings that call out over the land.
research.automagia.moblure.stage_1:
Set the Siren's Lure into a vertical line of obsidian totems, at least two besides itself. Creatures within eight blocks across walk to it, as far up and down as the line reaches and up to four blocks beyond; a jar of desiderium within four blocks doubles the reach. Endermen teleport closer. Where lures overlap, the one with the taller line wins.

Golems, bosses and slimes ignore it, as does any creature in a fight. One that gets no closer for ten seconds is let go for half a minute. Right-click it with a wand to switch it off and on.
research.automagia.moblure.title: Siren's Lure
research.automagia.nethermind.stage_0: The Nether presses close against our world, and a mind tuned to fire might reach across and take from it. The heart of a blaze would be the place to start.
research.automagia.nethermind.stage_1:
Blazes slain by your hand sometimes drop an ember heart. Infused into a crystalline brain of ignis it makes a Nethermind, which calls blocks across from the Nether.

Set the Nethermind in runed obsidian: a ring of eight around it at its height, one above, one below, and two in a row out from each side, eighteen in all. Right-click it with a wand to start it (this takes vis from the wand) and again to stop it; it tells you if the structure is wrong.

Each conjuring draws ignis vis through a vis relay (or from the aura itself) and its rune's essentia from jars within eight blocks. Plain runed obsidian calls netherrack mostly, with now and then soul sand, gravel, quartz, magma, glowstone or lava, for a little ignis and terra. Blocks appear at random in the 9x9x9 space two blocks below the structure, wherever there is room.

Runes of Rock (netherrack) and Sea (lava), and the other block runes, call only their own block and add it to the mix. With four or more block runes, only their blocks come at all.
research.automagia.nethermind.title: Nethermind
research.automagia.netherrune_bat.stage_: Each kind of creature answers to its own rune.
This rune calls fire bats through a Dimensional Lure. Make it from runed obsidian and two of what it is keyed to.
research.automagia.netherrune_bat.title: Runes of the Bat
research.automagia.netherrune_celerity.s: Plain runes call what the Nether throws at them. A rune cut with purpose calls one thing.

A rune of Celerity calls nothing of its own: each one hurries the Nethermind along, up to twelve, which more than halve the time between conjurings. Make it from runed obsidian and two of what it is keyed to.
research.automagia.netherrune_crystal.st: Plain runes call what the Nether throws at them. A rune cut with purpose calls one thing.
A rune of Crystal calls nether quartz ore, for terra and vitreus. Make it from runed obsidian and two of what it is keyed to.
research.automagia.netherrune_ghast.stag: Each kind of creature answers to its own rune.
This rune calls ghasts (the lure must be at least 8 blocks down) through a Dimensional Lure. Make it from runed obsidian and two of what it is keyed to.
research.automagia.netherrune_skeleton.s: Each kind of creature answers to its own rune.
This rune calls wither skeletons through a Dimensional Lure. Make it from runed obsidian and two of what it is keyed to.
research.automagia.netherrune_slime.stag: Each kind of creature answers to its own rune.
This rune calls magma cubes through a Dimensional Lure. Make it from runed obsidian and two of what it is keyed to.
research.automagia.netherrune_soul.stage: Plain runes call what the Nether throws at them. A rune cut with purpose calls one thing.
A rune of Soul calls soul sand and now and then soul soil, for terra and spiritus. Make it from runed obsidian and two of what it is keyed to.
research.automagia.netherrune_soul.title: Runes of Soul
research.automagia.netherrune_wisp.stage: Each kind of creature answers to its own rune.
This rune calls hellfire wisps, wisps of ignis through a Dimensional Lure. Make it from runed obsidian and two of what it is keyed to.
research.automagia.netherrune_wisp.title: Runes of the Wisp
research.automagia.netherrune_zombie.sta: Each kind of creature answers to its own rune.
This rune calls zombified piglins through a Dimensional Lure. Make it from runed obsidian and two of what it is keyed to.
research.automagia.overseer.stage_1: Golems go about their work without anyone watching. These are the devices that watch them, and the creatures around them, and act on what they see: the golem linking bell, the golemic inhibitor and the Signum Entia.
research.automagia.overseer.title: Arcane Overseer
research.automagia.redcrystal.stage_0: Some materials crystallised the right way become pliable to magic: their structure can be rearranged and even made to hold instructions. Redstone is one of them.
research.automagia.redcrystal.stage_1: Redcrystal grows on any face of a block and carries a signal like redstone dust, one strength weaker at each crystal. It strongly powers the block it is on. It also passes signals around corners: two crystals on neighbouring faces of the same block pass the signal when the space between them is empty.
research.automagia.redcrystal.title: Redcrystal
research.automagia.redcrystal_amp.stage_: A redcrystal fired with ignis holds nothing back.

Any signal reaching amplified redcrystal leaves it at full strength, toward its output side only, so it also works as a diode. It takes a signal only from the side opposite its output. Right-click with a wand to turn the output.
research.automagia.redcrystal_amp.title: Amplified Redcrystal
research.automagia.redcrystal_dense.stag: Weak signals cannot pass through dense redcrystal: it gives out a signal at least as strong as its minimum, or none at all. Right-click with a wand to raise the minimum, sneak-right-click to lower it.
research.automagia.redcrystal_dim.stage_: Dim redcrystal never gives out more than its cap, though it can give out less. Right-click with a wand to raise the cap, sneak-right-click to lower it.
research.automagia.redcrystal_dim.title: Dim Redcrystal
research.automagia.redcrystal_merc.stage: With magic mirrors tying far places together, your signals ought to travel with the items.

Mercurial redcrystal is bound to a magic mirror or an essentia mirror: right-click the mirror with it, then place it within eight blocks of that mirror. It shares its signal with every mercurial crystal bound to the mirror at the other end of the link, wherever that is.
research.automagia.redcrystal_merc.title: Mercurial Redcrystal
research.automagia.redcrystal_res.stage_: Resonating redcrystal sends its signal straight out from its tip, up to fifteen blocks through open air, to another resonating crystal pointing back at it. If one hangs under a block, the other must stand on a block below it. The pair share a signal as if they touched.
research.automagia.redcrystal_res.title: Resonating Redcrystal
research.automagia.redstone_theory.stage: Redstone is taken for a mundane trade good, the stuff of clockwork and circuits. Look closer and its behaviour can only be called magical. A few simple devices would let you fold its logic into your craft.

The redstone inversion torch is a true inverter: where a redstone torch is only on or off, it gives out fifteen minus the strength reaching the block it is stuck to.

The hourglass delays and times signals. Right-click it or give it a redstone signal and the glass turns. Once the sand settles it sends a pulse. It sends its signal out of its left and right sides as placed and takes a signal from every other side. A comparator reads how much sand is still falling. Right-click it with a wand or a stick, or sneak-right-click it with an empty hand, to set the time, five seconds at a step, up to a minute.
research.automagia.redstone_theory.title: Redstone Theory
research.automagia.remote_comparator.sta: A comparator has to sit right against what it reads, and is forever in the way.

The remote comparator gives out the same signal a comparator would, for a block up to twenty blocks away. It sees through a crystalline eye: right-click the block to watch with the eye to attune it, then right-click the remote comparator with the eye to set it in place. An empty hand takes the eye back.
research.automagia.slivers.stage_0: Some workings need only a pinch of primal magic, and spending a whole vis crystal on them feels wasteful. There ought to be a way to split a crystal into smaller pieces.
research.automagia.slivers.stage_1: At the arcane workbench a vis crystal breaks into four slivers for very little vis. Fusing four slivers back into a crystal is possible, but it takes five times as much vis.
research.automagia.slivers.title: Slivers of Magic
research.automagia.slivers_travel.stage_: When one's far enough, a pinch of air and earth is all a paving stone of travel needs.
Slivers can stand in for crystals in the paving stone recipe: arcane stone bricks around one sliver of Aer and one of Terra make two stones.
research.automagia.slivers_travel.title: Slivers for Travel
research.automagia.slivers_warding.stage: Blocking a spot needs no whole crystal either: a sliver of fire and one of order will do.
Slivers can stand in for crystals in the paving stone recipe: arcane stone bricks around one sliver of Ignis and one of Ordo make two stones.
research.automagia.slivers_warding.title: Slivers for Warding
research.automagia.tally_box.stage_0: Knowing how full a chest is helps. Knowing how many of one thing it holds would help more.
research.automagia.tally_box.stage_1:
Place the tally box against a container, as you would a hopper, and right-click it with a runic list. It gives a full redstone signal out of its back when the container holds what a whitelist names (each at least its quantity), or, with a blacklist, unless it does. A wand switches Match between all named items and any of them. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand takes the list out.

With a remote comparator on top, the box reads the block that comparator watches (the comparator gives out nothing of its own). Pointed at another tally box it reads that box's target, and so on down a chain.
research.automagia.tally_box.title: Tally Box
research.automagia.tally_box_lens.stage_: A tally box only sees inside containers. Ground right, a lens would show it more.

Right-click a tally box with a lens to fit it; sneak-right-click with an empty hand, once the list is out, takes the lens back. The Unbound lens counts the loose items lying in the target space. The Yield lens counts what the target block would drop, by an ordinary tool and by one with Silk Touch, the larger of each.
research.automagia.tally_box_lens.title: Tally Box Lenses
research.automagia.tenacious_chest.stage: Some chests are meant to be emptied by machines, and machines do not know when to stop.
Hoppers, pipes and other devices can take items out of a tenacious chest, but it always keeps the last one of each kind. Your own hands can still take everything.
research.automagia.tenacious_chest.title: Tenacious Chest
research.automagia.thaumostatic_spire.st: Refuelling a thaumostatic harness by hand is a nuisance for a busy thaumaturge. The harness's own field could carry potentia through the air, if a brain of air kept the link.

Build a column: a chiseled quartz block at the bottom, then two or more thaumostatic pylons and one controller in any order with no gaps, and a block of thaumium on top with open sky above it. Right-click the controller with a wand to raise the spire.

Pipe potentia into the controller with essentia tubes. Every worn thaumostatic harness nearby that holds a warded jar of potentia, or an empty one, is topped up a little at a time, and each bit sent draws a little vis from the aura. It covers eight blocks out at first, four more for each pylon up to six; height doesn't matter. Pipe in aer and the reach doubles while it lasts; pipe in volatus and the flow speeds up, more with each pylon.

Each side of the controller takes one aspect: right-click a side with a wand to change it.
research.automagia.thirsty_tank.stage_0: The hunger that drives a hungry chest is not particular about what it eats. Given a tank instead of a chest, it might well become a thirst.
research.automagia.thirsty_tank.stage_1:
The thirsty tank drinks the liquids that touch it, a source block at a time, and holds eight buckets. It also follows an unbroken run of the same liquid out to a source, so a small pool can be drunk without moving the tank. Only liquids a bucket could pick up are drunk.

Beside a water source it draws water forever without taking the source. Buckets, pipes and golems fill and empty it as with any tank, and it fills and empties water bottles. Out in the rain it catches water, so keep it under a roof if it holds anything else. A comparator reads how full it is.
research.automagia.thirsty_tank.title: Thirsty Tank
research.automagia.thirsty_tank_glyph.st: A thirsty tank could do much more with a liquid than gather a few buckets of it, if it could be told what.

Aqueous admixture, an ink steeped in water's aspect, pressed onto a stone slab with the right object makes a glyph. Right-click a thirsty tank's side with a glyph to put it there, one per side, up to six. Some glyphs act toward the side they are on. Sneak-right-click a side with a wand to take its glyph back.

Void: it takes more than it holds and destroys the rest. Consumption: it slowly destroys what it holds, faster with more of them. Siphoning: it pours into the container on that side. Envy: it draws from the container on that side. Temperance: it drinks only while powered. Preservation: it never lets itself be emptied completely, so it keeps its liquid. Guzzler: it drinks faster, more so with each. Reservoir: it holds sixteen buckets more for each.
research.automagia.thirsty_tank_glyph_bo: A tank that can look in a direction for liquid could look for something else there.

With a glyph of the bovine, a thirsty tank stops drinking and looks out from that side, up to four blocks, for cows to milk. A cow it has milked must rest for a while before it is milked again; a glyph of the guzzler makes it look more often.
research.automagia.vis_reader.stage_0: A watched crucible never boils, but it can be measured.
research.automagia.vis_reader.stage_1:
The vis reader gives out a signal from the aspects in the block it is stuck to: a jar, a crucible, a reservoir, anything that holds them. Beside a remote comparator it reads the block that comparator watches instead (the comparator then gives out nothing of its own).

A wand sets it. Right-click changes the selected setting, and sneak-right-click selects the next. The Mode setting picks Total (all aspects together), Any (High) or Any (Low) (the fullest or emptiest single aspect), Aspect Count (one strength per aspect present) or Disabled. Capacity is Auto (a jar's own size) or a fixed amount, and the signal is how full the target is against it. Invert gives a full signal when empty. Output sends the signal to all sides or to one. Right-click it with a jar label to make it read only that aspect. A blank label reads every aspect again.
research.automagia.vis_reader.title: Vis Reader
research.automagia.vishroom_soup.stage_0: Vishrooms grow where magic pools, yet they seem useless to thaumaturgy: just going near one turns the stomach. Eating one would be foolish.
research.automagia.vishroom_soup.stage_1:
You ate one anyway. Vishroom stew, cooked with ordinary mushrooms to keep it down, is a dreadful meal: it leaves you queasy and hungry, yet for a while you see in the dark as never before.

Pour the stew into a thirsty tank and let it settle: four bowls make a bucket of vishroom soup. A pool of the soup grows mushrooms and vishrooms in the dim places around it, and standing in it brings on the whispers.
research.automagia.vishroom_soup.title: Vishroom Oddities
research.automagia.workbench_upgrades.st:
Right-click a side of the golem's workbench with an upgrade to fix it there; it takes four, one on each side. Sneak-right-click a side with a wand to take its upgrade off. The same kind stacks, up to four (fire up to two, order and entropy once).

Air: the golem's speed hurries the work, but it tires faster. Fire: one more pattern grid opens. Water: the golem tires more slowly. Earth: the golem's strength hurries the work, less than air does, and it tires more slowly. Order: leftovers go into the storage instead of being thrown out. Entropy: the item in the first storage slot becomes a placeholder; where the pattern has it, the golem tries each other item in storage, so one pattern of stick and white wool with a stick placeholder can dye wool every colour it has dye for. The placeholder itself is never used up, and the golem tires much faster.
research.automagia.xpstone.stage_0: A brain in a jar holds only so much. Knowledge set in stone keeps, and can be drawn off as a cordial.
research.automagia.xpstone.stage_1:
Beside a brain in a jar, the Soul Stone takes experience from it while it is more than half full and gives it back when it runs below a quarter. It holds 10000 points; broken, half of them spill out.

When it holds enough it drips enchanter's concentrate into an empty warded jar one or two blocks below it, which becomes a jar of enchanter's concentrate (up to 1000 points, kept when the jar is broken). An empty phial draws a Phial of Enchanter's Concentrate from it (100 points), which you can drink or pour back in; a glass bottle draws a bottle o' enchanting. A comparator reads how full the stone or the jar is.
research.automagia.xpstone.title: Soul Stone
spell.automagia.crafting.desc: Opens an arcane crafting grid; the caster pays the vis.
spell.automagia.crafting.name: Crafting
jei.automagia.infusion_enchanting.note: Adds one level; each level costs more essentia
automagia.msg.vis_reader_filter_off: The vis reader reads every aspect.
